description:
READ-ONLY. Assess whether an existing Odoo database can be upgraded to a newer major and HOW.
    Detects the DB's current Odoo major (from its `base` module), lists installed modules, flags any
    custom/OCA (non-core) modules that will need their own migration coverage, sizes the DB, and lays
    out the ordered steps. Community DBs upgrade via OpenUpgrade (OCA), ONE major at a time (17->18->19);
    Enterprise DBs use Odoo's official upgrade platform (handled separately). Nothing is modified - run
    this before `upgrade_run`. `target_major` defaults to current+1.
    Into 20: Community is refused (OpenUpgrade has no 20.0), Enterprise via the platform is unverified -
    recommend the new-database path instead (workflow: odoo20_move_order).
name: upgrade_assess
